owner_authority: Owner's latest explicit scoped instruction; mechanics and authored canon must not be silently contradicted.

fighter_biography.applies_to: new prose only; no retrospective edit of accepted examples
fighter_biography.genre: third-person authored baseline or fitting institutional document

fighter_memory.applies_to: new prose only; flexible evidence-bound target

universal_craft: Evidence and chronology come before style. Distinguish documented character knowledge at event time, intended audience, and genre in that order.
Person over fighter card: choose a specific formative choice, work habit, competing obligation or institutional response; no equipment-list characterisation.
Connected sentences and concrete consequences; no trailer fragments, cryptic metaphors, robotic three-line reveals, generic grimdark or compulsory punchline.
Diegetic document identifiers, seals and historical dates may appear when a real in-world document calls for them; never duplicate app-rendered system IDs, dates or source revisions.
Faction is a shared culture/rule-set, not a gang personality. Two player gangs of the same faction do not inherit each other's local voices.
Exemplars are illustrative, non-exhaustive literary evidence, never reusable templates or facts about another subject.
Nonhuman minds and external attachments do not inherit human worker interiority or hosting-gang identity.

Palanite Enforcers.frame: Imperial enforcement and Palanite institutions; neither Kły's pack culture nor Patrol's future local history is universal.
Palanite Enforcers.source: Portable skill references/palanites.md and NCCE voice registry

House Orlock.frame: House of Iron road crews and transport trade; do not prescribe Slag Eaters diction to unrelated Orlock gangs.

House Van Saar.frame: Technical clan expertise, scarcity, radiation burden and restricted access, not generic technology jargon.

Ironhead Squat Prospectors.frame: Independent acquisitive armed claim-holders, kin, great charters and practical dangerous technology.

Genestealer Cults.frame: Biological and kinship context only when a character is aware; no omniscient cult knowledge.

Geothermal Prospect Detail C-9.institutional_record: Labour Administratum dossier: purposeful codes, redactions, inconsistent ledgers, credible material discrepancies, restrained implication; bureaucracy reports its own priorities.
Geothermal Prospect Detail C-9.personal_voice: Plain deep-work labour Crew, shared routines, fatigue, responsibility; close-third or direct personal thought rather than mandatory cogitator terminology.
Geothermal Prospect Detail C-9.disclosure: Author's specific knowledge at event time first; audience/genre determine disclosure. Do not reveal secrets merely from faction classification.

The Slag Eaters.register: Orlock hauler/road-crew idiom, workshop pragmatism and dry humour. Spoken contractions sparingly, not every fighter forced into parody dialect.
The Slag Eaters.documents: Road-cap file, dispatch, workshop margin note, hire/beast handling as purpose warrants. No compulsory addendum punchline.

Kły Sprawiedliwości.upper_authority: Report to superiors makes credible effort at formal professional terminology; pack loyalty and pursuit mentality reveal themselves in decisions.
Kły Sprawiedliwości.internal: Operations and between-officer speech is human, direct, pack-minded; fighter personalities still vary. No robotic permanent cogitator register.
Kły Sprawiedliwości.secrecy: Never expose GM-only gang backstory without documented awareness.

Ethernetans 2.0.register: Specific field engineering, Tek-Nik-El restricted knowledge, radiation and maintenance consequences; never generic fake techno-poetry.
Ethernetans 2.0.documents: Induction, recovery report, field workshop, Archeotek restriction, cyberachnid equipment sheet as appropriate; unique knowledge cannot be generalized.

Helmaeth Expeditionary Force.register: Prospector ambition, hard bargaining, mining, defended claim, kin inheritance, willingness to risk for reward; not modern compliance office or fantasy dwarf caricature.
Helmaeth Expeditionary Force.documents: Actual role-specific charter, retainer, equipment custody, kin witnessing only where warranted; no mandatory ancestor consultation or four-section template.

policy_boundaries.biography_chars: Count full Markdown character length. Target 1900-2000 inclusive; >2300 fails hard. Existing imported examples at different lengths preserved.
policy_boundaries.faction_vs_gang: Palanite Enforcers is faction; Kły and Patrol are distinct gangs. Do not infer Patrol's voice from Kły.
policy_boundaries.knowledge: Character documented knowledge at event time takes precedence; then audience, then genre. Literary pattern cannot override chronology.
policy_boundaries.new_category: Unknown prose forms fall back to existing runtime restrictions; owner refinements are scoped and versioned, not guessed.
